failingTests: a cancel that raced the crash is CANCEL_UNKNOWN when replayed with its key, before and after reconciliation
a failed compensation is reported as such and is never COMPENSATED
a restart after a clean completion shows COMPLETED, and a cancel of it is too late (never unknown)
a second cancel with a new key is CANCEL_IN_PROGRESS while pending and ALREADY_TERMINAL afterwards
a start is refused while an action is in flight; replays are idempotent; stale and future epochs are rejected
a storm of parallel cancels racing the final step yields exactly one consistent outcome
a storm racing before step 4 yields exactly one consistent partial outcome
after a crash mid-step the action is INTERRUPTED, never cancelled or completed, and an intent without an effect is UNKNOWN
cancel after completion is CANCEL_TOO_LATE: a conflict, all effects stand, not a success
cancel before any step ran is CANCELLED_BEFORE_EFFECT with nothing to undo
cancel during step 3 is applied at the boundary: the step finishes and stands
cancel is idempotent per key; a different command under the same key conflicts and changes nothing
cancel while waiting before step 3 is CANCELLED_PARTIAL: steps 1 and 2 stand and nothing is undone
cancel with compensation is COMPENSATED only after journaled compensating steps ran in reverse order
reconciliation after a restart is an explicit, idempotent command that settles facts without claiming cancelled or completed
wrong lease, run, user, action, stale and future epochs are typed failures that claim and change nothing

note: The snapshots are byte copies of tests/*.cjs at RED time and were run from a scratch workspace with their original names.
